mapper.select: SELECT RR.READING_ROOM_ID, RR.ROOM_NAME, RR.FLOOR_NAME, RR.DESCRIPTION, RR.IS_ACTIVE, RR.CREATED_AT, COUNT(S.SEAT_ID) AS TOTAL_SEAT_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN S.IS_USABLE = 1 AND AR.SEAT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS AVAILABLE_SEAT_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN S.IS_USABLE = 1 AND AR.SEAT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS USING_SEAT_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN S.IS_USABLE = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DISABLED_SEAT_COUNT FROM READING_ROOMS RR LEFT JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.READING_ROOM_ID = RR.READING_ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT SEAT_ID FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('USING', 'RESERVED') AND START_TIME < #{endTime} AND END_TIME > #{startTime} ) AR ON AR.SEAT_ID = S.SEAT_ID WHERE RR.IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND RR.UNIV_ID = (SELECT UNIV_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) GROUP BY RR.READING_ROOM_ID, RR.ROOM_NAME, RR.FLOOR_NAME, RR.DESCRIPTION, RR.IS_ACTIVE, RR.CREATED_AT ORDER BY RR.READING_ROOM_ID

SELECT S.SEAT_ID, S.READING_ROOM_ID, RR.ROOM_NAME, S.SEAT_NUMBER, S.ZONE_NAME, S.IS_USABLE, CASE WHEN S.IS_USABLE = 0 THEN 'UNUSABLE' WHEN AR.RESERVATION_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'USING' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS SEAT_STATUS, AR.RESERVATION_ID, AR.MEMBER_ID AS RESERVED_MEMBER_ID, AR.START_TIME, AR.END_TIME FROM READING_ROOM_SEATS S JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RESERVATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, SEAT_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('USING', 'RESERVED') AND START_TIME < #{endTime} AND END_TIME > #{startTime} ) AR ON AR.SEAT_ID = S.SEAT_ID WHERE S.READING_ROOM_ID = #{readingRoomId} AND RR.IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND RR.UNIV_ID = (SELECT UNIV_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(S.SEAT_NUMBER, '^[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(S.SEAT_NUMBER) ELSE NULL END, S.SEAT_NUMBER
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION_PENALTIES WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT PENALTY_ID AS penaltyId, PENALTY_TYPE AS penaltyType, REASON AS reason, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PLEDGED' THEN END_TIME ELSE NULL END AS resolvedAt FROM RESERVATION_PENALTIES WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, PENALTY_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RESERVATION_PENALTIES ( PENALTY_ID, MEMBER_ID, PENALTY_TYPE, REASON, START_TIME, END_TIME, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_RESERVATION_PENALTIES.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{penaltyType}, #{reason}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '100' YEAR(3), 'ACTIVE', SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE RESERVATION_PENALTIES SET STATUS = 'PLEDGED', END_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM READING_ROOM_SEATS S JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID WHERE S.SEAT_ID = #{seatId} AND S.IS_USABLE = 1 AND RR.IS_ACTIVE = 1
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS ( RESERVATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, SEAT_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{memberId}, #{seatId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'RESERVED'), SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.SEAT_ID, S.READING_ROOM_ID, RR.ROOM_NAME, S.SEAT_NUMBER, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS R JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = R.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID WHERE R.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.SEAT_ID, S.READING_ROOM_ID, RR.ROOM_NAME, S.SEAT_NUMBER, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS R JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = R.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY R.START_TIME DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS IN ('USING', 'RESERVED')
mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_ID, ROOM_NAME, 'MEETING_ROOM' AS ROOM_TYPE, NULL AS FLOOR_NAME, NULL AS LOCATION, CAPACITY, EQUIPMENT AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(IS_AVAILABLE, 1) AS IS_ACTIVE, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS CREATED_AT FROM MEETING_ROOMS WHERE NVL(IS_AVAILABLE, 1) = 1 AND UNIV_ID = (SELECT UNIV_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) ORDER BY ROOM_ID
SELECT RESERVATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, ROOM_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME, STATUS FROM MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS WHERE STATUS IN ('USING', 'RESERVED') AND START_TIME < #{endTime} AND END_TIME > #{startTime}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEETING_ROOMS WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND NVL(IS_AVAILABLE, 1) = 1
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS ( RESERVATION_ID, MEMBER_ID, ROOM_ID, START_TIME, END_TIME, PURPOSE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{memberId}, #{roomId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{purpose}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'RESERVED'), SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.ROOM_ID, MR.ROOM_NAME, 'MEETING_ROOM' AS ROOM_TYPE, MR.CAPACITY, R.PURPOSE, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN R.STATUS != 'RESERVED' THEN NULL WHEN CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) < R.START_TIME THEN 'BEFORE' WHEN CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) < R.START_TIME + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE AND CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) < R.END_TIME THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'EXPIRED' END AS CHECK_IN_STATE, R.START_TIME + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE AS CHECK_IN_DEADLINE FROM MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS R JOIN MEETING_ROOMS MR ON MR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(R.STATUS)) IN ('USING', 'RESERVED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, R.START_TIME DESC

SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.ROOM_ID, MR.ROOM_NAME, 'MEETING_ROOM' AS ROOM_TYPE, MR.CAPACITY, R.PURPOSE, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN R.STATUS != 'RESERVED' THEN NULL WHEN CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) < R.START_TIME THEN 'BEFORE' WHEN CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) < R.START_TIME + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE AND CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) < R.END_TIME THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'EXPIRED' END AS CHECK_IN_STATE, R.START_TIME + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE AS CHECK_IN_DEADLINE FROM MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS R JOIN MEETING_ROOMS MR ON MR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS IN ('USING', 'RESERVED')
mapper.select: SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.ROOM_ID, MR.ROOM_NAME, 'MEETING_ROOM' AS ROOM_TYPE, MR.CAPACITY, R.PURPOSE, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, NULL AS CHECK_IN_STATE, R.START_TIME + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE AS CHECK_IN_DEADLINE FROM MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS R JOIN MEETING_ROOMS MR ON MR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.STATUS = 'USING' AND R.END_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)

SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.ROOM_ID, MR.ROOM_NAME, 'MEETING_ROOM' AS ROOM_TYPE, MR.CAPACITY, R.PURPOSE, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, 'EXPIRED' AS CHECK_IN_STATE, R.START_TIME + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE AS CHECK_IN_DEADLINE FROM MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS R JOIN MEETING_ROOMS MR ON MR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND R.START_TIME + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS SET STATUS = 'COMPLETED' WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND STATUS = 'USING' AND END_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND START_TIME + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE MEETING_ROOM_RESERVATIONS SET STATUS = 'USING' WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND START_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND START_TIME + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE > CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND END_TIME > CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.SEAT_ID, S.READING_ROOM_ID, RR.ROOM_NAME, S.SEAT_NUMBER, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS R JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = R.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID WHERE R.STATUS = 'USING' AND R.END_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)

SELECT R.RESERVATION_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.SEAT_ID, S.READING_ROOM_ID, RR.ROOM_NAME, S.SEAT_NUMBER, R.START_TIME, R.END_TIME, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT FROM READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS R JOIN READING_ROOM_SEATS S ON S.SEAT_ID = R.SEAT_ID JOIN READING_ROOMS RR ON RR.READING_ROOM_ID = S.READING_ROOM_ID WHERE R.STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND LEAST( GREATEST(NVL(R.CREATED_AT, R.START_TIME), R.START_TIME) + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE, R.END_TIME ) <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS SET STATUS = 'COMPLETED' WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND STATUS = 'USING' AND END_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND LEAST( GREATEST(NVL(CREATED_AT, START_TIME), START_TIME) + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE, END_TIME ) <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE READING_SEAT_RESERVATIONS SET STATUS = 'USING' WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND START_TIME <= CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND LEAST( GREATEST(NVL(CREATED_AT, START_TIME), START_TIME) + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE, END_TIME ) > CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AND END_TIME > CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP)
